patentAlternative.title: Real-time data-lineage engine for regulated pipelines
patentAlternative.inventor: Dr. S. Iyer, Dept. of Computer Science
patentAlternative.brief: A method for automated, audit-grade data lineage across streaming financial pipelines - directly relevant to BFSI compliance.
patentAlternative.decisionInThread: Evaluated against the Polaris acquisition for closing Anchor's gap.
patentAlternative.verdict: License-and-build considered; did NOT beat Polaris because the patent supplies invention-side IP but not the trained senior bench and live BFSI client relationships Anchor needed on a 12-month horizon. Kept as a Year-2 licensing option to deepen the acquired capability.

targetSourcing.thesisFilter: founder-led, balance-sheet vulnerable, BFSI-friendly, senior bench depth

tasDimensions.label: Transactability
tasDimensions.note: valuation headroom + promoter/succession exit signal + distress/turnaround

tasDimensions.label: Strategic fit
tasDimensions.note: capability match to the named gap + fragmentation/roll-up fit

tasDimensions.label: Integration risk (inverse)
tasDimensions.note: size ratio + founder-dependency + regulatory/execution friction (India reg lane)

tasDimensions.label: Data confidence
tasDimensions.note: how much is AlphaSense-supplied vs needs manual enrichment

targetSourcing.scaleNote: Each dimension scored 0-100; TAS = weighted sum. Scarcity is a tie-breaker, not a scored factor.

longlist.name: Polaris Data Group
longlist.capabilityMatch: Specialty data engineering - exact match to the gap; strong BFSI client base.
longlist.dataConfidenceNote: Financials + ownership AlphaSense-supplied; succession/culture manually enriched.

longlist.name: Meridian Analytics
longlist.capabilityMatch: Adjacent analytics; partial gap fit. PE ownership lowers transactability (price + timing).

longlist.name: Cobalt Systems
longlist.capabilityMatch: Strong bench but generalist; higher integration risk (founder-dependency, thin process).
longlist.dataConfidenceNote: Private; succession + margin trend need manual enrichment.

outreach.note: Three names cleared the thesis filter; Polaris chosen on highest TAS + exact capability match.
